case_number: 2024 INSC 590; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 2828-2829 OF 2023; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 112 OF 2024
summary: Appeal challenging conviction under IPC s.302, s.120B; acquittal under s.323 upheld; FIR delay issues; eyewitness statement unrecorded; adverse inference against prosecution for concealing daily diary entry; inconsistency in witness account regarding crime scene presence; conviction restored pending further evidence scrutiny.
legal_provisions_cited: Tomaso Bruno & Anr. v. State of Uttar Pradesh (2015) 7 SCC 178
final_judgment: Appeal pending final order; interim decision to examine evidence discrepancies; conviction subject to further review.
